C1062.title: Aiding Information Network Crime: Four Defendants Sentenced to Prison and Fines
C1062.summary: Between February and March 2023, four defendants in Xingwen County, Sichuan, knowing that their upstream contacts were conducting telecom fraud overseas, privately set up and operated VOIP equipment in domestic hotels to provide communication transmission support for the fraud ring.
